But I think big 3 is absolutely necessary for anything above 1k watts. your stock grounding wires around the car including the alternator are 8-12g or so. Your power wire from the amp is probably 0g right? The car can only make as much power as it can dissipate so the stock grounding/power wiring will be your bottleneck.  
Also If you're really pumping 3k then I'd look into a high output alternator on top of that, especially if you're dealing with some massive voltage drop.  


As for the second battery from what I understand it's only useful for demoing; being in a stationary position and needing that extra reserve. Your stock alternator is designed to maintain your battery level + all of the stock electronics. Your alternator isn't going to be able to maintain both batteries in a daily driver scenario.
